free_tier.stated: Free Basic: 5 flipbooks, unlimited pages, 1 GB storage, 1 user, no watermark, API access included.

egress.terms: Unlimited visits, no ads, no watermark on free; offline download of the flipbook HTML is offered ("download the html to host it yourself").

tooling: Real documented API + MCP server: create/list/delete flipbooks, access lists, embed codes, webhooks; API key via 'Authorization: Bearer'. Third-party python libs exist but nothing first-party for bulk sync.
chaining: 1 GB/account x unlimited free accounts; the API means it is automatable, but 1 GB units mean 1 TiB == 1,024 accounts and 10 TiB == 10,240. Only interesting as a serving front, not as bulk storage.
limits_note: 1 GB total disk per account; 5 flipbooks on free; PDF is converted to page assets rather than stored byte-for-byte; over-quota accounts get 'old flipbooks auto removal'.
reliability_note: Over-quota accounts are subject to automatic deletion of old flipbooks, and free accounts hold only 5 publications.

evidence.proved: 'Basic Free - 5 free flipbooks - Unlimited pages - Unlimited visits - No ads - API access - 1GB storage'
'the total disk space of your flipbooks and assets can't exceed your user's disk space'; auto-removal of old flipbooks when over quota
